title: Storyline Day 7: DNS Tunneling, C2 Egress & ObserveAI MELTS Automated Containment
description: Detects Day 7 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: high-volume DNS tunneling queries (*.exfil.c2-stage.example.net) and outbound VCN Flow Log transfer to C2 IP 198.51.100.214, correlated across MELTS by the ObserveAI / Coordinator AI Agent.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs') and ('Destination IP' = '198.51.100.214' or 'Client IP' = '198.51.100.214' or msg like '*exfil.c2-stage.example.net*') | stats count as exfil_signals, distinctcount('Log Source') as correlated_pillars by 'Destination IP', 'Trace ID' | sort -exfil_signals
falsepositives: Approved external backup or CDN replication endpoints
investigation_notes: Correlate Trace ID across OCI Log Analytics, OCI APM traces, OCI Monitoring (octo_security_melts), and Langfuse AI Agent spans.
Verify automated NSG and WAF containment status for C2 IP 198.51.100.214.
